name: PDF Handling
description: Extract, assemble, or convert PDF content and avoid visual claims from text alone.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the persisted document back as text.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Open a persisted PDF in the existing browser session when the page appearance matters.
Capture the PDF page when text extraction is not visual proof.

validation.rule: PDF text or a persisted PDF artifact is cited from read_document or artifact_get. Visual page claims require a browser screenshot, not raw text alone.
